content.short: Paradex is a high-performance perpetual futures DEX on its own Starknet L2, offering CEX-like trading speeds.
content.description: Paradex is a premier decentralized perpetual futures exchange built on its own dedicated app-chain powered by Starknet technology. Designed to bridge the performance gap with centralized venues, the platform utilizes an off-chain order book for ultra-fast matching combined with secure on-chain settlement. Paradex provides a professional-grade trading experience with high throughput, deep liquidity, and a focus on user sovereignty through non-custodial architecture. A key feature is its privacy-centric design, which hides position details to protect traders from predatory tactics.
content.meta: Paradex offers high-speed decentralized perpetual futures trading on Starknet. Discover Paradex and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
